Fully opened UGA 2021–26 official institutional contract identifies Université Pierre-Mendès-France as one of three predecessors merged into Université Grenoble Alpes in 2016. The OM List entry labels a doctorate from Pierre Mendès France with year 2018, two years after the predecessor ceased as an independent university. This establishes a real predecessor/successor identity but a conflict in that individual's reported label/year; preserve the original imported facts, do not relabel the degree to UGA or treat the historic school as a current duplicate provider.

limitations: Broad Management Sciences school title is not quantitative Management Science and is excluded; its five named specialties include no Operations or Industrial Engineering.

The broad Gestion school title is not itself a quantitative Management Science qualification.

Official I-MEP² doctoral school names five PhD specialty domains, including GI Industrial engineering: conception and production. This is the one title-eligible engineering specialty evidenced, while mechanics, materials, electrochemistry and process fields are distinct.
